matrix_name.name: Carboxyl-containing polyimide
matrix_name.description: Carboxylate-containing polyimide (PIC) fiber prepared by wet spinning, high-temperature cyclization, and hot drawing at 380 °C; activated/etched in NaOH then ion-exchanged with Ni2+ and reduced to form Ni nanoparticles as catalytic seeds prior to Cu electroless plating.

fillers.name: Copper
fillers.description: Electroless-plated Cu layer on PIC fiber; Cu layer weight ratio controlled by plating time; reported as PIC/Cu-8%.

matrix_name.description: Carboxylate-containing polyimide (PIC) fiber; NaOH activation (12 min selected as optimal), Ni2+ ion exchange and NaBH4 reduction to form Ni nanoparticles prior to Cu electroless plating.

fillers.name: Copper
fillers.description: Electroless-plated Cu layer; reported as PIC/Cu-35%.

matrix_name.description: PIC/Cu-35% fiber further activated in PdCl2 solution (0.005 M PdCl2 containing 0.01 M HCl) then electroless nickel plated (80 °C, 1 min) to form protective Ni layer; reported as PIC/Cu-Ni. Nickel layer weight ratio to PIC fiber matrix reported as 20%.
